entries.diff_text: Line 108: Line 108: }} }} ==Strategy== *Although its single target damage is rather poor, the '''Pulse Trooper''' excels at clearing out crowds thanks to its pulses damaging every enemy in its range. **Due to this, spots which cover a lot of the path but also are in close proximity due to the '''Pulse Trooper''' having low range are best suited for it. Examples of such path layouts include loops or u-turns. **Range boosting towers like the [[DJ Booth]] can be very beneficial for this towers thanks to this, as it will extend how far the pulses can reach, effectively boosting its potential DPS. *At Level 4, it unlocks ''Sweeper'', an ability that unleashes two lasers that cover the whole map. **As two lasers are fired at once, each dealing damage to an enemy once, this effectively means the ability deals 350 damage to each enemy on the map at Level 4 and 600 at Level 5, which if all '''Pulse Troopers''' are placed down it can deal up to 2,450 or 4,200 damage per enemy for Level 4 and Level 5 respectively. **This is best used on high enemy count waves due to its map wide range. *Thanks to its infinite pierce, the '''Pulse Trooper''' can be very effective on maps with [[All Paths]] as its attacks can clear out the duplicated enemies quite well. **This is especially true for its ''Sweeper'' ability which can deal damage to every single enemy on the map, making it way more effective on such maps. *Although the '''Pulse Trooper''' only has lead detection, it can damage other enemy types with its attacks. **Its main attack can damage [[Flying]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, however, this only works if there is a detectable enemy in range. If no enemy is in range, they will simply walk through it unharmed. **The ''Sweeper'' attack can also damage them, however, as it activated by the player, it can even be used when there are only such enemies on the map. *Stalling towers can be useful with the '''Pulse Trooper''' as they will be able to help keep enemies in its range for longer, increasing its DPS. *The '''Pulse Trooper''' due to its practically infinite max hits can be used to hit multiple enemies at once, allowing it to generate multiple fireworks at once with the [[Firework Technician]]. **Do note however that its chance is reduced per enemy hit, meaning against a single target it will generate far less fireworks than a regular tower with the same firerate. ==Gallery== ==Gallery==
